sources.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Produce SOURCE PIXEL ART ANIMATION CELS for a 2D overhead wuxia RPG. Input images are visual references. Each cell contains exactly one entire matching chibi man facing screen RIGHT in the same elevated top-down three-quarter view; all foot positions registered on a consistent ground line inside cells, no camera changes. 8 images, centered in separate equally spaced cells, generous empty alpha gutters so limbs and swords never cross cell borders. Draw crisp detailed hand-pixelled compact bodies like the small bodies in image 2 (approximately 2.6 heads tall) with limited palette and deliberate pixel clusters. Top row: plum-robe grey-bearded master with real thin straight jian, exact trinkets from image 1. Four distinct animation poses in reading order: standing idle, drawing sword arm back with legs bent, strong right-facing sword thrust with hand extended and legs split, withdrawing sword with planted rear foot. Bottom row: same exact man with bare muscular torso, same head, topknot, red ribbons, sash, graphite trousers, boots, no weapon whatsoever. Four distinct animation poses in reading order: relaxed idle empty hands, lean back preparing two-finger gesture, strong forward thrust with two fingers, recovering with one hand at chest. No VFX, no glitter, no sword qi, no props, no text, no display stand. Require true alpha, no baked checkerboard. Large subjects occupy about 65% of cell height and maintain equal scale across rows. Intent is authored isolated sprite frames, not a concept illustration.
